<thought>Since functional‑group searches did not return a template, I will search for templates that specifically form an O–Si bond. In the bond notation used by the tool, the bond is described by the atomic numbers of the two atoms, i.e., oxygen (8) and silicon (14). By searching for templates that form the bond “8-14” while breaking an aliphatic hydroxyl (the O–H bond of the alcohol), I expect to retrieve the silylation template that converts an alcohol into a trimethylsilyl ether. The result will contain the template ID and the mapped reaction SMILES needed for the answer.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "bonds_formed": ["8-14"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
